summary: Drowning in a Collection of Rumi and looking to my ear know Now I am no Poet Empty words. Spilled pixels lashed to frozen vessels sailing seas of impossibilities in Doldrums of inferiority No More #smallpoems
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
Drowning in a Collection of
  Rumi
and looking to my
   ear
  know Now I am no
Poet
Empty words. Spilled pixels
 lashed to frozen vessels
sailing seas of impossibilities
 in Doldrums of inferiority
No More
#smallpoems
